_readme: Seed content for wknd-next. Create each folder under AEM_DAM_ROOT (default /content/dam/wknd-next/en), then each fragment on the named model. Image paths point at the WKND Universal assets on the XSC Showcase; if your sandbox doesn't have them, upload images (see images[]) and update the paths. The hero variations must be named after the persona slugs (title 'Maya Surfer' -> node maya_surfer -> matches persona maya-surfer). Publish everything, and the five models, when done.

fields.termsReference: Torres del Paine — W Circuit open
fields.termDetails: Open: all W Circuit sections are open. Mirador Base Las Torres closes to ascents after 14:00. Expect gusts to 90 km/h on the Los Cuernos section.
Park entry must be purchased online before arrival. Rangers check refugio or campsite reservations at every checkpoint. Carry a printed or offline copy.
Open flames, including stoves, are only permitted in designated cooking shelters. Pack out everything you pack in. Fines start at CLP 1,000,000.
